name: gradient-october-silenceiver
title: October Silenceiver
description: A decorative slightly diagonal gradient block that starts in bright cyan-blue, passes through periwinkle, and ends in vivid violet-magenta at the far edge.
use: A vivid cool-toned field is wanted behind a hero, card or announcement.
avoid: Its saturated stops are static and bright, so delicate text or quiet layouts will fight it.
a11y: Decorative only: no text, controls or focus, so it conveys no information by itself. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded rectangle filled by a shallow diagonal gradient from bright cyan-blue on the left, through periwinkle blue, to a vivid violet-magenta on the right. Black margins frame it.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds. The two saturated colour stops are fixed, though classes or inline styles can resize and repaint the block.
customise: The two gradient stops are baked into the inline style; pass className or style to resize, round or repaint it, otherwise edit the file.
weight: light: One div with a CSS gradient and no script.
polishWhy: Smooth diagonal blend with clean corners; striking but still a stock two-colour gradient.
